brand.tagline: The smart link between recruiters and talent

landing.title: Artificial intelligence for frictionless recruiting.
landing.subtitle: Predictive matching, CV analysis and an AI assistant — for candidates, recruiters and companies.
landing.candidateDesc: Upload your CV, get tailored offers and track your applications.
landing.recruiterDesc: Publish offers, rank applications with AI scoring and schedule interviews.
landing.adminDesc: Company moderation, AI quotas and audit log.
landing.neutral: AI assists; the final decision stays human
landing.heroTitle: The right candidate, the right job, no friction.
landing.heroSub: HireLink analyses CVs, scores each match clearly, and brings interviews, messages and HR documents together in one place — in French, English and Arabic.
landing.trust2: Explained scores, never a black box
landing.howSub: Three steps, from first click to signature.
landing.step1Title: Upload a CV or post a job
landing.step1Desc: The CV (PDF or DOCX) is analysed and your profile fills itself in. Recruiters describe the role and set a match threshold.
landing.step2Desc: Every application gets a score, with the skills found and the ones missing.
landing.step3Desc: Messaging, interviews added to your calendar, then a contract or agreement ready to print.
landing.c1: Profile filled in automatically from your CV
landing.c2: One-click applications with your score visible
landing.c3: Applications and interviews tracked in one place
landing.r1: Jobs with must-have and nice-to-have skills
landing.r3: Interviews, messages and HR documents together
landing.f1Desc: Skills, experience and location: you know why a profile ranks high.
landing.f2Desc: One conversation per application, with instant notifications.
landing.f3Desc: Contract, internship agreement and certificate, printable as PDF.
landing.f4Desc: Role-based access: candidate, recruiter or administrator.
landing.ctaSub: Create your account in a minute, then post your first job or upload your CV.
